failureReloadPartialStaleConcurrent.midStepFailure: Actual illegal-answer refusal on a Kael discard prompt for both controllers preserves the uncommitted payment. Insufficient energy omits activation and rejects application without energy or exhaust payment. No new exception or recovery mechanism is introduced.
failureReloadPartialStaleConcurrent.reload: Both-controller scratch structured-clone reload preserves the suspended discard prompt. Twenty native selected/opposite presentation cases preserve exact committed state and UUID through reload; Kasane additionally preserves its armed delayed effect. Constructor history is absent from the new probe cache after reload.
failureReloadPartialStaleConcurrent.partialApplication: Kael payment remains absent while its prompt is pending, and cancellation preserves the entire side state on both controllers. Costs and activation commit through the existing atomic fold. No external partial-write protocol is added.
failureReloadPartialStaleConcurrent.invalidStaleInput: An invalid deck-card answer returns illegalAnswer; cancellation and reopening mint a different prompt ID; an old answer returns stalePrompt. Both controllers observed.
failureReloadPartialStaleConcurrent.concurrentActors: Duplicate answer after commit returns noPendingPrompt. Independent controller fixtures exercise the same APIs; no shared mutable concurrency protocol is added. These semantic witnesses do not assert a policy choice or timing threshold.
